final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT AVG(step1.station_avg), AVG(step1.station_avg - step2.overall_avg) FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND step1.station_avg > step2.overall_avg
